purpose: Frozen synthetic structural-neighbor sanity set for comparing mathematical retrieval representations before proof-search evaluation.
nonclaims: Top-1 retrieval on this set does not establish HDC search advantage.
The set is a manipulation check, not a research benchmark.

cases.structural_law: Preserve forall/Real/equality/addition shape while ignoring bound-variable spelling and exact ordinary small-positive literal magnitude.
Alpha renaming must preserve the neighborhood while premise/conclusion reversal and conjunction must not be treated as the same structure.
Repeated use of one canonical variable must remain distinguishable from two distinct variables and from an operator change.
Alpha renaming must preserve forall-exists nesting while reversed quantifier order and changed inner numeric type remain distinguishable.
Addition child order should not change the structural neighborhood, while subtraction and relation changes should.
